verall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
val-runs/get-one-runs-stage-analytics.md): ONE run's materialized stage-analytics document: where its trials fell out of the six-s
tage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent
, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-
quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_co
nfigured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-di
sable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of
its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-e
nvironment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (async)](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target (attached proje
ct environments, or attached named hosts) under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution and responds `202
` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs
/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and respo
nds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (pas
sing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resol
ve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is b
y `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector pa
rses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attached environments,
hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and
write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and i
ts cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-a
n-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array
sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear.
Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suite
s-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required: `
steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run
. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the single create, an
d the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-em
pty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually: a `failed`…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's to
ols](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server t
ools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them: the only edit route that connects to a server. S
ynchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite'
s tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam
's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an eval authoring job]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/g
enerate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished au
thoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the
-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped
** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in anothe
r suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Rem
oves the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the cas
e's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall ba
ck to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores on
e artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's re
sults then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run
artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers
`410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later up
load a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the
run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-au
thenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport
and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run
evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run
evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabiliti
es remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-
eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SD
K reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mi
nt-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted
inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically a
